testimonials.name: Brian Osbourne
testimonials.text: I can't recommend Audrey at The Way Agency highly enough! From our very first conversation, she was knowledgeable, attentive, and committed to finding the best coverage for our needs. She took the time to understand our situation, answered all my questions with patience and clarity, and made the entire process seamless.

testimonials.name: Olivia Mitchell
testimonials.text: Rebecca has been wonderful  -  she is personable, helpful and organized. We are so grateful for her!

testimonials.name: September Board
testimonials.text: Audrey was personable and took time to review our current coverage to make sure we made the right choice.

testimonials.name: Ace Boogie
testimonials.text: In times when you can't drive without insurance, it's such a relief to have a company that treats you like family and honestly takes care of you the right way. Highly recommended!

testimonials.name: Poseidon CRC
testimonials.text: Josh was top notch and super helpful in making my transition over to their services. Thanks Josh!

testimonials.name: Kelsey Watson
testimonials.text: Courtney was amazing! She was patient and went over everything with me in detail. She was very knowledgeable and helped me choose the best plan to fit my needs. I would absolutely recommend The Way Agency to anyone looking for coverage! No one better.

testimonials.name: Lisa Moore
testimonials.text: Finding Rebecca has been such a blessing! Not only did she save me a ton of money but she also doubled my coverage. Apparently buying online was not as smart as I thought it was. I'm so glad I found The Way Agency.

testimonials.name: Mark Hensley
testimonials.text: Kelly helped us get our general liability and commercial auto coverage set up when we started our landscaping business. She explained everything in plain English and found us a policy that was about 30% less than what we were quoted elsewhere. Couldn't be happier.

testimonials.name: Dana Crawford
testimonials.text: Jill walked me through every Medicare option and never once made me feel rushed. She even called back the next day to make sure I understood my coverage. This is what insurance should feel like.

testimonials.name: Travis & Emily Rogers
testimonials.text: We bundled our home, auto, and umbrella through The Way Agency and saved over $400 a year compared to our old setup. Audrey made the switch painless — everything was done in one afternoon.

testimonials.name: Randy Pike
testimonials.text: Had a tree fall on our garage during a storm last spring. Sheilia personally helped us through the claims process from start to finish. The adjuster came out within two days and we had a check in hand within a week. That kind of service is hard to find.

testimonials.name: Jason Whitfield
testimonials.text: Kelly got us our surety bond and workers comp policy sorted out in less than 48 hours so we could start a job on time. She understands what contractors actually need and doesn't waste your time with stuff you don't.

testimonials.name: Patricia Owens
testimonials.text: Jill helped my husband and me both get term life policies and walked us through exactly how much coverage we actually needed based on our mortgage and kids' ages. No pressure, no upselling — just honest advice.

testimonials.name: Michael Bennett
testimonials.text: When my policy came up for renewal, Audrey shopped it across multiple carriers to make sure I was still getting the best rate. She found me better coverage for $15 less a month. That kind of proactive service is why I'll never go back to a big-box insurer.

testimonials.name: Amanda Stokes
testimonials.text: We own a small restaurant in Owensboro and Kelly put together a BOP that covered our equipment, liability, and even business interruption. She took the time to visit our location and really understand our risks. Best decision we made for our business.

testimonials.name: Carl & Nancy Taylor
testimonials.text: After a minor fender bender, I was dreading dealing with insurance. Sheilia's team handled everything — filed the claim, followed up with the adjuster, and kept me updated the whole time. I barely had to lift a finger.

testimonials.name: Derek Lang
testimonials.text: Switched our commercial property and cyber liability to The Way Agency after our last carrier raised rates with no explanation. Kelly found us comparable coverage and saved us nearly $2,000 annually. She actually fights for her clients.

testimonials.name: Sarah Klein
testimonials.text: I called in a panic after realizing my flood insurance had lapsed right before storm season. Audrey got me a new policy within days and even found a better rate than what I'd been paying. She genuinely cares about her clients.

testimonials.name: Robert Miles
testimonials.text: Jill helped me find an affordable individual health plan after I left my corporate job. She compared five different options side by side and helped me pick the one that actually made sense for my situation. Saved me hours of research.

testimonials.name: Bradley Back
testimonials.text: Absolutely love The Way Agency. Kelly is amazing she has always taken care of my family I wouldn’t have insurance anywhere else.

testimonials.name: Mitchell “Capt.Mitch” Davis
testimonials.text: Kelly is just the best so helpful.

testimonials.name: Brooke White
testimonials.text: I love supporting a Faith Based Company any chance I get. You won’t find anyone more genuine, compassionate and caring than Audrey Lilpop and Sheila Royal. Truly a dynamic pair and no one I’d rather have taking care of all my insurance needs. Audrey walked me through each step, ensuring it was a smooth transition and was able to save us over $4,000/year—providing the same coverage at a fraction of the cost. She’s honest and trustworthy. I knew I was in the best hands throughout the transition and will continue to be protected each day moving forward too.

testimonials.name: Stephanie Burger
testimonials.text: I appreciate Audrey Lillpop and her dedication, honesty, and knowledge while walking me through the insurance process

testimonials.name: Caleb Royal
testimonials.text: A great family owned business. They saved me several hundred dollars on my insurance plan! They were also extremely quick with my quotes as well!

testimonials.name: Jim Ivy
testimonials.text: It has been a pleasure to work with Audrey.  Rates are less than I had been paying and some extra perks.

testimonials.name: Misty Wells
testimonials.text: Great experience. Transition made easy! Thanks Audrey!

testimonials.text: Met Audrey my agent today and she was so kind and helpful, looking forward to many years of business together .
